select a.*, d.depart_name as deptName,p.post_name as postName,u.realname as realName from ( SELECT m.dept_code, m.post_id, m.inspected_by, COUNT(*) as plannedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN m.is_edit = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as actualCount FROM mes3_manager_checklist_edit_main m WHERE m.del_flag = 0
and m.dept_code LIKE CONCAT( #{dept}, '%' )
and m.post_id IN (${postId})
and m.create_time >= #{checkDateBegin} and m.create_time <= #{checkDateEnd}
GROUP BY m.dept_code, m.post_id, m.inspected_by ) a LEFT JOIN sys_depart d ON a.dept_code = d.org_code LEFT JOIN mes3_mdm_post p ON a.post_id = p.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.inspected_by = u.id
